pages.text: Build the boiler using JEI, prepare a reliable water supply and connect appropriate steam transport. Supply water before heating it and monitor the system while it starts.$(br2)Do not let a boiler run unattended with an uncertain water supply. If it runs dry or behaves unexpectedly, stop and consult its operating information before attempting a restart.
Give the boiler enough output capacity for the machines it supplies. If several machines stop together, check steam production and delivery before assuming each machine has failed.
